name: Product list with category browse
purpose: Site v0 has no product list, so shoppers cannot see the 10 products or browse by category.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the card count or any supplied price or size differs from the brief after one retry.

outputs: products section in the site file
completion_check: 10 cards show the supplied names, prices and sizes; clicking each of the 5 category tabs shows the right count (10, 3, 3, 2, 2).

name: WhatsApp order buttons
purpose: Shoppers cannot order from the site.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if any button href lacks the 910000011111 number or its product name after one retry.

outputs: order script and button styles in the site file
completion_check: Each of the 10 buttons has an href starting https://wa.me/910000011111?text= containing its product's URL-encoded name.

name: Earthy elegant theme
purpose: The site has no earthy, elegant look and no mobile-first styling.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if horizontal scroll appears at 360px or 1280px after one retry.

outputs: theme CSS and viewport tag in the site file
completion_check: Viewport meta tag is present, heading font is a serif, and there is no horizontal scroll at 360px or 1280px.

name: Shop name, Pune and single h1
purpose: Page shows no visible Thread & Loom name and no mention of Pune; there is no h1.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the page has zero or more than one h1, or Pune is not visible, after one retry.

outputs: hero section with the single h1 in the site file
completion_check: Page has exactly one h1 containing Thread & Loom, the word Pune is visible, and the product line names kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.

name: Size and price filters
purpose: No size or price control exists, so visitors cannot narrow the 10 products.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if a size or price choice gives a wrong card count, or free-size items vanish from the size filter, after one retry.

outputs: filter controls and script in the site file
completion_check: Choosing a size or price range changes the visible card count correctly; Sarees and Dupattas still show under any size choice; no JS errors.

name: Responsive and link hygiene
purpose: Item 14 (viewport, no overflow, no JS errors, no broken links) is built but unpaid.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if horizontal scroll appears at 360px or 1280px, or any in-page link is broken, after one retry.

outputs: responsive rules and in-page nav links in the site file
completion_check: Viewport tag present; no horizontal overflow at 360px or 1280px; zero JS errors; zero broken in-page links.
